analysis_strategy.stage_1: Build sequence-only whole-genome distance/tree and structural feature inventory across the panel.
analysis_strategy.stage_2: Identify multiple independent close branch contrasts using the frozen tree and trait key.
analysis_strategy.stage_3: Compute Biological Diff for each contrast before annotation reveal.
analysis_strategy.stage_4: Intersect recurrent structural/rewiring deltas across independent contrasts.
analysis_strategy.stage_5: Apply body-size, depth, phylogenetic and composition controls; preserve conflicting branches.
analysis_strategy.stage_6: Reveal annotation and compare recovered subsystems to known longevity biology; do not equate overlap with causality.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: TRANSFER
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Held-out structural recurrence survives predefined tests/nulls.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: RETRODICT
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Hidden observed phenotype/trait state is predicted before reveal.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: INTERPOLATE
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Predict states between supported observed points with calibrated uncertainty.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: CROSS-CONTEXT TRANSFER
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Mechanism/state mapping transfers to an independent lineage/context.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: EXTRAPOLATE
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Propose unobserved but constraint-compatible states; must remain explicitly hypothetical until observed or tested.

prediction_maturity_ladder.name: INTERVENTION
prediction_maturity_ladder.requirement: Predict effects of perturbation; requires independent experimental validation and cannot be inferred from visualization alone.
